name: minalytics
description: Tiny (~1 KB gzipped), cookieless, typed analytics client for the self-hosted minalytics server.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/script.ts --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/script.js && tsc && node -e "try{require('fs').copyFileSync('dist/script.js','../server/public/a.js')}catch{}"
